summary: Juben Thakur (South Asia Representative) introduced Leeds Arts University to TOC counselors, covering its two-campus structure (the historic Vernon Street campus for foundation students, and the modern Blenheim Walk campus for undergraduate/postgraduate study), its shift toward non-portfolio creative-business courses, and its entry requirements for Indian students -- roughly 55% for Foundation/Postgraduate and 65% for Undergraduate -- alongside scholarships of GBP 2,000 or more.
keyInsights: Two campuses: Vernon Street (foundation, dating to 1903) and Blenheim Walk (undergrad/postgrad, built in the 1980s).
Entry requirements for Indian students: ~55% for Foundation/Postgraduate, ~65% for Undergraduate.
Scholarships of GBP 2,000+ are available to international students.
